item.title: AI Won't Replace Engineers - But It Will Change How We Build
item.description: AI is becoming a practical engineering partner, not a substitute for accountable technical judgment.

item.title: Simulation-First Engineering: Shortening the Loop
item.description: Shorter design cycles come from better simulation habits, not bigger models or more process overhead.

item.title: Modular Aircraft: Why Reconfigurability Matters
item.description: Reconfigurable aircraft architectures reduce organizational risk and increase mission adaptability.

item.description: Endurance comes from operational discipline and integration quality more than any single breakthrough.

item.title: Building an Innovation Lab Inside a Big Company
item.description: A practical playbook for creating a rapid innovation environment that survives contact with reality.
